supplements.title: Effect of Diosmetin on Gut Microbiota and Serum Metabolites in Acute Pancreatitis Mice: A Metagenomic and Metabolomic Study.
supplements.summary: Diosmetin reduces pancreatic damage in acute pancreatitis mice by restoring healthy gut bacteria and their metabolites.

supplements.title: The Gut-Liver Axis in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: From Mechanistic Insights to Precision Therapeutics.
supplements.summary: Gut bacteria changes cause fatty liver disease; targeting microbiome with probiotics and personalized treatments offers new therapy options.

supplements.title: Effects of Cannabidiol on TAFAZZIN-Deficient B-Lymphoblastoid Cells.
supplements.summary: Cannabidiol restored growth and corrected cardiolipin defects in Barth Syndrome patient cells, improving mitochondrial function.

supplements.title: Parthenolide Attenuates Skeletal Muscle Atrophy Through Regulation of Protein Homeostasis and Inhibition of Inflammation.
supplements.summary: Parthenolide, a compound from feverfew, reduces skeletal muscle atrophy by suppressing inflammation and restoring muscle protein levels in mice.

supplements.title: Evaluating the Efficacy of Polyphenol-Enriched Plant Extracts and Pathway Modulators in the Bone Marrow to Suppress Breast Cancer Progression.
supplements.summary: Plant extracts combined with pathway modulators reduced breast cancer spread by suppressing inflammatory and angiogenic signals in the bone marrow microenvironment.

supplements.title: Philippine marine macroalgae as sources of bioactive natural products and macronutrients for food applications.
supplements.summary: Philippine seaweeds show potential as food sources and cancer-fighting agents, with some species producing bioactive compounds effective against cancer cells.

supplements.title: TMEM11 promotes cisplatin resistance by inhibiting BNIP3-mediated mitophagy in bladder cancer.
supplements.summary: TMEM11 protein promotes cisplatin resistance in bladder cancer by blocking cell death, and blocking TMEM11 with Curcumin restores drug sensitivity.

supplements.title: Activity of Didesmethylrocaglamide in High Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer Using Preclinical In Vitro and In Vivo Models.
supplements.summary: Didesmethylrocaglamide, a rocaglamide derivative, kills high-grade serous ovarian cancer cells, including chemotherapy-resistant ones, in laboratory and mouse studies.

supplements.title: Optimization and chemical modification of exopolysaccharides from lactic acid bacteria: multi-functional health-promoting properties and structure-activity relationship.
supplements.summary: Chemically modified bacterial compounds from fermented bamboo shoots inhibited lung cancer cell growth and migration in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Cardioprotection in oncology: Mechanisms, risks and therapeutic strategies.
supplements.summary: Cancer drugs and radiation damage the heart through different mechanisms; exercise and lifestyle changes show promise, but better preventive treatments are urgently needed.

supplements.title: Effects of different exercise interventions on cognitive function in patients with breast cancer: A systematic review and network meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Exercise improves cognitive function in breast cancer survivors, with certain types showing greater benefit than others.

supplements.title: Penicillide Triggers Immunogenic Pyroptosis in Tumor Cells via Oxidative Stress/NF-κB/GSDMD Signaling Axis.
supplements.summary: Penicillide, a fungal compound, kills cancer cells through pyroptosis and triggers immune responses, showing promise as an immunotherapy treatment.

supplements.title: Novel Therapeutic Strategies for Tumor Treatment via Regulation of the Ferroptosis Mechanism Using Artemisinin Derivatives and Nanomedicines.
supplements.summary: Artemisinin derivatives trigger ferroptosis, a cell death mechanism, offering a new cancer treatment approach with improved drug delivery.

supplements.title: Astragalus membranaceus sprouts and their unique constituents regulate reactive oxygen species production, inflammation-related senescence-associated secretory phenotype components, and extracellular matrix in fibroblasts.
supplements.summary: Astragalus sprouts contain unique flavonoids that reduce aging signs in cells by activating antioxidant pathways and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Bioprospecting of the Amazonian mapati fruit (Pourouma cecropiifolia Martius): Antiproliferative and antimalarial potential of peel and seed hydroethanolic extracts.
supplements.summary: Mapati fruit extracts from the Amazon show promise against lung cancer cells and malaria parasites while protecting DNA from damage.

off_label.title: Bafetinib enhances anti-tumor immunity by activating the NLRP3 inflammasome in macrophage.
off_label.summary: Bafetinib activates immune cells in tumors by triggering a protein called NLRP3, enhancing cancer treatment when combined with immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Repurposing lurasidone to alleviate doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity and neurotoxicity via BDNF/TrkB/PI3K/Akt/CREB and miR-34a-5p/PGC-1α pathways.
off_label.summary: Lurasidone protects the heart and brain from doxorubicin chemotherapy damage in rats by reducing toxicity and inflammation.

off_label.title: Small-molecule CBLB inhibitor abolishes EGFR ubiquitination, reduces receptor endocytosis, and diminishes cell motility signaling.
off_label.summary: A new drug blocks EGFR ubiquitination and reduces cancer cell movement in oral squamous cell carcinoma by preventing receptor internalization.

off_label.title: NEK8 kinase-mediated lactate increase impairs antitumor immunity decreasing radiotherapy sensitivity in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: NEK8 kinase promotes colorectal cancer radioresistance by increasing lactate, which suppresses immune T cells; blocking NEK8 restores immunity and improves radiotherapy.

off_label.title: Dinaciclib reduces MCL-1 levels and triggers apoptosis in adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.
off_label.summary: Dinaciclib kills adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma cells by lowering MCL-1 protein levels and triggering programmed cell death.

off_label.title: Lactate-mediated NK cell dysfunction as a prognostic marker and therapeutic target in breast cancer.
off_label.summary: High lactate in breast tumors suppresses natural killer cells; blocking lactate restores immune cell function and tumor killing in breast cancer.

off_label.title: Pharmacologic targeting of the dopamine D2 receptor impacts the efficacy of immune checkpoint blockade in melanoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking dopamine D2 receptors with FDA-approved drugs may enhance immune checkpoint inhibitor effectiveness in treating melanoma.

off_label.title: Multifactorial Intervention of Primary Prevention in High Risk Subjects: a Randomized Trial
off_label.summary: A combination of smoking cessation, low-dose aspirin, diet changes, and CT screening may reduce cancer risk in heavy smokers.

off_label.title: Burosumab treatment in an adult with FGF23-mediated hypophosphatemia due to cutaneous skeletal hypophosphatemia syndrome.
off_label.summary: Burosumab successfully treated an adult with rare cutaneous skeletal hypophosphatemia syndrome by targeting FGF23 protein instead of requiring multiple daily medications.

off_label.title: Malignant transformation in patients with monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance treated with teriparatide for osteoporosis: a bicenter retrospective study and analysis of the French national pharmacovigilance database.
off_label.summary: Teriparatide appears safe for osteoporosis patients with precancerous blood cell changes, with minimal cancer progression observed.

off_label.title: Lithium carbonate-loaded polymeric nano-micelles for enhanced antitumor activity against NF1-associated malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors via improved cellular uptake.
off_label.summary: Nano-encapsulated lithium carbonate more effectively kills nerve sheath tumor cells by increasing drug uptake and triggering cell death pathways.

off_label.title: The Unfinished Agenda in Helicobacter pylori Treatment: Resistance, Microbiome Effects, and Future Directions.
off_label.summary: H. pylori antibiotic resistance and microbiome disruption threaten effective gastric cancer prevention, requiring new treatment approaches.

off_label.title: Cerebroprotective potential of ceftriaxone against cadmium chloride-induced cerebral inflammatory changes and oxidative insult.
off_label.summary: Ceftriaxone protects mouse brains from cadmium toxicity by reducing inflammation and oxidative damage while improving cognitive function.

off_label.title: A novel combination therapy for ER+ breast cancer suppresses drug resistance via an evolutionary double-bind.
off_label.summary: Researchers found that combining chemotherapy with disulfiram in ER+ breast cancer forces resistant cells into an evolutionary trap, restoring drug sensitivity.

off_label.title: AdipoR1-AMPK axis suppresses breast cancer across molecular subtypes via multimodal cell death pathways, including ferroptosis and apoptosis.
off_label.summary: Activating the AdipoR1 protein kills breast cancer cells through multiple mechanisms, including ferroptosis and apoptosis, across all molecular subtypes.

biomarkers.title: 2H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-amine derivatives as novel selective fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) inhibitors.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered PLW559, a new selective drug that blocks FGFR2 protein and stops growth of FGFR2-dependent cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: Diagnostic performance and generalizability of a clinical-ultrasound radiomics model for predicting extrathyroidal extension in thyroid carcinoma: a retrospective study.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed an ultrasound-based model combining imaging patterns and clinical data to accurately predict thyroid cancer spread beyond the thyroid gland.

biomarkers.title: Patient acceptance of HPV self-sampling approach for cervical cancer screening: evidence from a pilot study in Kazakhstan.
biomarkers.summary: Women in Kazakhstan showed high acceptance of self-sampling HPV tests for cervical cancer screening in a pilot study.

biomarkers.title: G/C-ending and synonymous codon bias define functional translational programs that shape human tissue and cancer proteomes.
biomarkers.summary: Codon choice in genes controls protein production, with A/T-biased codons driving cancer cell growth and G/C-biased codons promoting normal differentiation across cancer types.

biomarkers.title: Unusual Gastrointestinal Bleeding due to an Aberrant Artery Neighboring a Jejunal Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor.
biomarkers.summary: A jejunal gastrointestinal stromal tumor caused unusual bleeding from a neighboring aberrant artery, discovered through imaging and surgery.

biomarkers.title: CCNB2, NUSAP1, GTSE1, and TK1: potential dual biomarkers for pneumonia and lung adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Four genes (CCNB2, NUSAP1, GTSE1, TK1) drive both lung adenocarcinoma and pneumonia, offering potential diagnostic and treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Effect of Diosmetin on Gut Microbiota and Serum Metabolites in Acute Pancreatitis Mice: A Metagenomic and Metabolomic Study.
biomarkers.summary: Diosmetin reduces pancreatic damage in acute pancreatitis mice by restoring healthy gut bacteria and their metabolites.

biomarkers.title: Lactate Metabolism-Immune Regulation-Related Gene Signature in Lower-Grade Gliomas: Prognostic Model Development and Immune Characterization.
biomarkers.summary: A three-gene signature predicts survival in low-grade gliomas and identifies patients who may benefit from specific cancer drugs.

biomarkers.title: The Gut-Liver Axis in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: From Mechanistic Insights to Precision Therapeutics.
biomarkers.summary: Gut bacteria changes cause fatty liver disease; targeting microbiome with probiotics and personalized treatments offers new therapy options.

biomarkers.title: Effects of Cannabidiol on TAFAZZIN-Deficient B-Lymphoblastoid Cells.
biomarkers.summary: Cannabidiol restored growth and corrected cardiolipin defects in Barth Syndrome patient cells, improving mitochondrial function.

biomarkers.title: CBP/β-Catenin Signaling in Hepatocytes Plays Pivotal Roles in MMP-7-Mediated Liver Fibrosis in a Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis Mouse Model.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking MMP-7 protein reduces liver fibrosis in a metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease mouse model, offering a potential treatment target.

biomarkers.title: CSDE1 Drives Glycolysis and the Progression of Prostate Cancer Through RAC1-Dependent RAS/MAPK Activation.
biomarkers.summary: CSDE1 protein drives prostate cancer growth by activating a signaling pathway that increases cancer cell energy production and spread.

biomarkers.title: FNDC1 Competitively Binds Gβ2 to Suppress the β-Catenin-Destruction Complex and Promote Gastric Cancer Malignancy.
biomarkers.summary: FNDC1 protein drives gastric cancer growth by disrupting a key signaling pathway that normally suppresses tumor development.

biomarkers.title: Glucokinase Inactivation Reduces Lysophosphatidylcholine Accumulation to Alleviate High-Fat Diet-Induced Hepatic Steatosis.
biomarkers.summary: Reducing glucokinase activity decreases harmful lipid buildup in the liver, protecting against fatty liver disease.

biomarkers.title: Parthenolide Attenuates Skeletal Muscle Atrophy Through Regulation of Protein Homeostasis and Inhibition of Inflammation.
biomarkers.summary: Parthenolide, a compound from feverfew, reduces skeletal muscle atrophy by suppressing inflammation and restoring muscle protein levels in mice.

trials.title: Diagnostic performance and generalizability of a clinical-ultrasound radiomics model for predicting extrathyroidal extension in thyroid carcinoma: a retrospective study.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an ultrasound-based model combining imaging patterns and clinical data to accurately predict thyroid cancer spread beyond the thyroid gland.

trials.title: Patient acceptance of HPV self-sampling approach for cervical cancer screening: evidence from a pilot study in Kazakhstan.
trials.summary: Women in Kazakhstan showed high acceptance of self-sampling HPV tests for cervical cancer screening in a pilot study.

trials.title: Lactate Metabolism-Immune Regulation-Related Gene Signature in Lower-Grade Gliomas: Prognostic Model Development and Immune Characterization.
trials.summary: A three-gene signature predicts survival in low-grade gliomas and identifies patients who may benefit from specific cancer drugs.

trials.title: The Gut-Liver Axis in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: From Mechanistic Insights to Precision Therapeutics.
trials.summary: Gut bacteria changes cause fatty liver disease; targeting microbiome with probiotics and personalized treatments offers new therapy options.

trials.title: Recent advances in the management of pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors: From diagnosis, treatment to biology.
trials.summary: New blood tests and imaging analysis improve early detection and treatment planning for rare pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.

trials.title: Copper ionophores drive divergent responses to immune checkpoint inhibition across colorectal tumor models.
trials.summary: Copper-binding drugs show promise with immunotherapy in colorectal cancer, but their effectiveness depends on tumor type and drug chemistry.

trials.title: FIG4 downregulation-arrested autophagy-lysosomal degradation of IL-18 drives lipid-associated macrophage polarization and immunotherapy resistance in triple-negative breast cancer.
trials.summary: FIG4 overexpression breaks immunotherapy resistance in triple-negative breast cancer by reducing immune-suppressive macrophages through IL-18 degradation.

trials.title: The vulnerabilities of chemotherapy resistant pancreatic cancer revealed by organoids of pre- and post-neoadjuvant therapy.
trials.summary: Pancreatic cancer organoids reveal that chemotherapy activates KRAS signaling, making resistant tumors vulnerable to KRAS inhibitors.

trials.title: IL-6 drives chemoimmunotherapy resistance in NSCLC by reprogramming myeloid cells and impairing cytotoxic lymphocyte function.
trials.summary: High IL-6 levels predict chemoimmunotherapy resistance in lung cancer by suppressing immune cells that fight tumors.

trials.title: Enhanced prediction of breast cancer patient response to chemotherapy by integrating deconvolved expression patterns of immune, stromal and tumor cells.
trials.summary: A new analysis method predicts breast cancer chemotherapy response by examining immune and stromal cell expression patterns alongside tumor cells.

trials.title: A Bilayer Feature Fusion Framework for Pan-Cancer Survival Prediction Based on Multihead Attention and Adaptive Differential Privacy: Model Development and Validation Study.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new method to predict cancer survival across multiple cancer types while protecting patient privacy.

trials.title: Is Saturation Biopsy Still a Viable Alternative to Fusion Biopsy in the Era of Multiparametric MRI? A Comparative Analysis in Patients With Prior Negative Biopsy.
trials.summary: Saturation biopsy remains effective for detecting prostate cancer in men with previous negative biopsies, comparable to newer MRI-fusion techniques.

trials.title: Development of Machine Learning Models for Predicting Prostate Cancer in Biopsy Candidates Using Prostate-Specific Antigen, Magnetic Resonance Imaging, and Hematologic Parameters.
trials.summary: Researchers developed machine learning models combining PSA levels, MRI scans, and blood tests to better predict prostate cancer in biopsy candidates.

trials.title: Impact of Intraprostatic Simultaneous Integrated Boost on Long-Term Outcomes in Unfavorable Intermediate-Risk Prostate Cancer Treated With Dose-Escalated Radiotherapy and Short-Term Androgen Deprivation Therapy.
trials.summary: Boosting radiation dose to the prostate tumor itself improved outcomes for intermediate-risk prostate cancer patients receiving standard treatment.

trials.title: Identifying gene expression signatures for risk stratification of postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy in colorectal cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers identified gene expression biomarkers to help predict which colorectal cancer patients need chemotherapy after surgery.

mind_body.title: Music in the Last Hours: Finding Humanity in the ICU.
mind_body.summary: Personalized music played at a cancer patient's bedside in the ICU reduced distress and provided comfort during final hours of life.

mind_body.title: Intolerance of uncertainty and attitudes toward cancer as predictors of spiritual well-being in patients with cancer.
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients' spiritual well-being is predicted by their tolerance of uncertainty and their attitudes toward their cancer diagnosis.

mind_body.title: Implementing video-based group music therapy during cancer treatment: insights from a mixed-methods study.
mind_body.summary: Video-based group music therapy helps cancer patients participate in beneficial therapy sessions despite treatment-related physical limitations.

mind_body.title: Mapping global research trends of Tai Chi for sleep health: Scientometric insights and network-based perspectives.
mind_body.summary: Tai Chi, a gentle mind-body exercise, shows promise as a safe alternative treatment for improving sleep quality and addressing sleep disorders.

mind_body.title: A Randomized Controlled Trial Examining the Effect of a Web-Based Filial Therapy Program on Parental Role Perception Among Parents of Children With Cancer
mind_body.summary: A web-based filial therapy program helped parents of children with cancer better perceive their parenting role through structured play training.

mind_body.title: A Multicomponent Support Program to Enhance Quality of Life in Chinese Cancer Patients and Survivors (MSP-CCS): Pilot Optimization Trial and Implementation Outcomes
mind_body.summary: A support program combining education, counseling, and peer support improves quality of life for Chinese cancer patients and survivors.

mind_body.title: 'Being empathetic to my patients and ourselves': a qualitative process evaluation of READ-Y psychological first aid training for healthcare workers working in routine care.
mind_body.summary: Healthcare worker training in psychological first aid improves empathy and communication while supporting staff well-being in routine hospital care.

mind_body.title: Music as Supportive Care for Young Children with Sickle Cell Disease and their Parents: A Three-phase Qualitative Exploration into the Cultural Relevance of Active Music Engagement with Black Families.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy sessions involving parents and children show promise in reducing distress for Black families managing sickle cell disease.

mind_body.title: Evaluation of Spiritual Care among Oncologists and Nurses at the Oncology Departments, Marrakech, Morocco.
mind_body.summary: Moroccan nurses report significantly higher awareness of spiritual care for cancer patients than oncologists, suggesting targeted training is needed.

mind_body.title: Hope, strength, and survival: exploring positive psychology interventions in breast cancer care.
mind_body.summary: Positive psychology interventions like gratitude and mindfulness boost hope and resilience in breast cancer patients beyond traditional symptom-focused care.

mind_body.title: Effects of warm needle acupuncture on behavioral pain threshold in a rat model of migraine.
mind_body.summary: Warm needle acupuncture effectively increases pain tolerance in migraine-affected rats, suggesting benefits for migraine treatment.

mind_body.title: FearLess in Neuro-Oncology: Phase I trial targeting fear of cancer recurrence in patients with primary malignant glioma and their caregivers.
mind_body.summary: A new therapy called FearLess helps glioma patients and caregivers reduce anxiety about cancer recurrence.

mind_body.title: Symptom distress and treatment interest for cognitive decline in neuro-oncology.
mind_body.summary: Brain tumor patients experience cognitive decline that causes distress, and researchers are identifying treatment preferences to develop better support programs.

mind_body.title: Cancer in Poetry-Poetry in Cancer: A Linguistic Analysis of Poems by Poets on Their Own Cancer and on the Cancer of Their Loved Ones.
mind_body.summary: Analyzing cancer poems reveals how poets use writing to process their own cancer diagnosis and support loved ones facing the disease.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Non-pharmacological interventions on pain and fatigue management in cancer survivors: A systematic review and meta-analysis study.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture and reflexology effectively reduce pain in cancer survivors, while physical activity shows minimal benefit for pain or fatigue.
